name: Issue 3185: Glyphic Destruction doubles Glyphic Ruin's damage against Frozen targets
contract: Glyphic Destruction 800758 reads 'Increases the damage of Glyphic Ruin by 100% against Frozen targets.'
MiscValueB 4 (AURA_STATE_FROZEN), BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = 100, classmask family 38 word0 bit12 (4096),
TargetA caster. This is the established OVERRIDE_CLASS_SCRIPTS -> native aura 303
(MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE) conversion pattern already used for Cinderstorm Runes 706458; before this
fix no registration existed for 800758, so the raw selector 20007 did nothing (no handler reads it). Glyphic
Ruin 520067-520070/572119-572122/801179 are the only family 38 spells carrying word0 bit12 (4096). Frost Nova
122 (Frost school, SPELL_AURA_MOD_ROOT) always maps to AURA_STATE_FROZEN through the native
SpellInfo::GetAuraState(), the same fixture the sibling Frost Spectre scenario uses. Expected: once converted,
Glyphic Ruin deals double damage against a target frozen by Frost Nova and normal damage against an unfrozen
